import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n = data[0]
    p = [0, 0] + data[1:]  # p[i] is parent of i, 1-indexed

    path = []
    cur = n
    while cur != 0:
        path.append(cur)
        if cur == 1:
            break
        cur = p[cur]

    path.reverse()
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(map(str, path)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
